pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pDuplicates eligible stackable input using circuit boards and a large FE batch. The blacklist excludes protected progression items.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Put one eligible stackable item and seven circuit boards in the first eight input slots.$p2. Accumulate the current full batch cost; the default is 1.5 billion FE.$p3. Leave room for four copies and let the batch complete.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pUnstackable or blacklisted items are refused. Increasing cable voltage does not bypass the item blacklist or the FE requirement.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
